traces: Layer 04 Runtime Controls & Observability: execution traces — agent runs and spans emitted as the system operates.
guardrail: Layer 04 Runtime Controls & Observability: guardrail events, such as blocked tool calls, emitted at the point of action.
regstate: Layer 04 Runtime Controls & Observability: registry state — the scope and status of each registered model, agent and system.
checks: Layer 05 Assurance & Continuous Compliance: the control checks that run continuously against the signals rather than at a quarterly review.
records: Layer 05 Assurance & Continuous Compliance: the evidence records each check writes on one schema — control_id, subject and version, decision, metric, threshold, actor, timestamp and signature — keyed on the registry id.
dashboard: A live dashboard whose control-status tile is backed by a query over the records; if a control stops firing the tile goes red within minutes.
auditor: The auditor, for whom the audit becomes a query over the store and drift is visible in near real time.
